HISTORY AND PHYSICAL Cascadia Lakes Medical Center Date of admission: 08/12/2068 SORENSEN, E MRN RL-0762215 43 M
Dictated but not read.
CHIEF COMPLAINT: chest pressure with exertion for 2 weeks.
HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS: This is a 43 year old single man with emphysema, obstructive sleep apnea on CPAP, essential hypertension, obesity, prediabetes and metabolic syndrome who is seen after a wellness visit on 08/05/2068 at which his blood pressure was 150 over 109 and a cardiac CT and stress test were arranged. Imaging, read by the radiology group as showing abnormal findings of the heart and coronary circulation, was reported on August 15th, no wait, that is the date of the follow up, the report was dated 08/05/2068. He describes substernal pressure walking up one flight, relieved in about ten minutes with rest. No syncope. No fever. He smokes, one pack per day for many years, and is trying to stop.
PAST MEDICAL HISTORY: As above. Vitamin B12 injections for anemia. Previously on hydrochlorothiazide, fluticasone and albuterol until 07/08/2063.
MEDICATIONS ON ADMISSION: B12 injection monthly. Nothing else. ALLERGIES: No known drug allergies.
SOCIAL: Lives alone. Brother is the contact. Unemployed lately.
EXAM: BP 150/109, HR 88, SpO2 94 percent on room air. Obese. Barrel chest, diminished breath sounds. Regular rhythm, no murmur. No edema.
LABS: total cholesterol 170.7, LDL 111.9, hemoglobin A1c 5.9, glucose 76.6.
ASSESSMENT/PLAN: Ischemic heart disease with abnormal imaging, angina. Start clopidogrel, simvastatin 20 mg, metoprolol succinate 100 mg and nitroglycerin spray as needed. Admit for observation and catheterization planning. Aspirin to be added by cardiology. Nicotine counseling. Marisol Teixeira-Banda, MD Pager 5509
